text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraq rejects idea of Israel joining project to link power grids of Iraq, Syria, Jordan, Egypt and Turkey.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz stresses in Moscow importance of implementing paragraph 22 of U.N. resolution 687 on ending embargo on Iraq's oil exports.
(Above stories also carried by Jumhouriya and Qadissiya)
- U.N. sanctions committee allows Pakistan to fly airliners to Baghdad.
- Iraq and Algeria holding talks to conclude oil deals.
